# Ole Dyg Pedersen

Ole Dyg Pedersen is a senior physician (Overlæge) at [[sjaellands-universitetshospital|Sjællands Universitetshospital]] who serves on the steering committee of [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK), Denmark's national quality registry for atrial fibrillation treatment [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

He appears in the steering committee listing of the AFDK annual report covering the period 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023, in the chapter describing the database's data foundation, patient-population definitions, and the composition of the steering group [^src1]. He is also named in the subsequent annual report covering 1 July 2023 to 30 June 2024 — a report notable for presenting, for the first time, data submitted by practising cardiologists who began reporting to the database on 1 June 2023, and for covering 22,073 incident and 136,420 prevalent atrial fibrillation patients evaluated against eight main quality indicators [^src2]. In that 2024 report, Pedersen is identified specifically as one of the "Forpersoner for databasen" (chairpersons/leaders of the database) [^src2], and he is again listed among the steering group members in the section documenting patient representatives' views on structured patient education, the implementation of systematic patient education at Hospitalsenhed Midt since 2012, and AFDK's status as a nationwide quality database approved under the Dansk Cardiologisk Selskab and the Sundhedsstyrelsen [^src3].

Across all three appearances, Pedersen's institutional affiliation is consistently given as Sjællands Universitetshospital [^src1] [^src2] [^src3], and his role places him among the leadership guiding the database's methodology, data quality oversight, and reporting on regional and national variation in atrial fibrillation care in Denmark.
